content: OTel/LLM tracing: OpenTelemetry explicitly makes the implementer responsible for PII in telemetry; default is data minimisation (do not collect what you do not need), with attribute/redaction/transform processors to hash/delete/truncate. For LLM agents, prompts and outputs ARE the sensitive payload. On a CPU-only host, full-fidelity spans add overhead and trace bloat; use sampling and keep the clinical audit chain (hash-chained) as the source of truth, with traces as a derived/secondary view.
